commitments.detail: Pick up the telescope at 19:00 on the day of the rental.
Return the telescope by 01:00 on the day of the rental.
Use the telescope between 19:30 and 00:30 on the night of the rental.
Pay a cash deposit of $25 upon collection.
Pay a rental fee of $50 upon return.
Ensure the telescope is transported in a padded case.
